---
# TEMPLATE for the per-worker agents generated by `orch.ps1 create`.
# A concrete file is written to `.kilo/agent/workers/worker-<id>.md` with:
#   - `edit`/`write`: broad '**': deny first, then one allow entry per allowed dir
#   - `read`: '*': allow then explicit deny entries for secret-like files
#   - an explicit deny entry for every side-effecting tool a worker must not use
#     (deterministic denies are used instead of a global '*' wildcard).
description: ANARA orchestrated worker <WORKER_ID> (generated; do not edit by hand)
mode: primary
model: nvidia/deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4.1-flash
permission:
  edit:
    '**': deny
    '<SANDBOX_DIR>': allow
    '<SANDBOX_DIR>\*': allow
    '<WORKER_RECORD_DIR>': allow
    '<WORKER_RECORD_DIR>\*': allow
  write:
    '**': deny
    '<SANDBOX_DIR>': allow
    '<SANDBOX_DIR>\*': allow
    '<WORKER_RECORD_DIR>': allow
    '<WORKER_RECORD_DIR>\*': allow
  read:
    '*': allow
    '**/*.env': deny
    '**/*.env.*': deny
    '**/*.pem': deny
    '**/*.key': deny
    '**/id_rsa*': deny
    '**/credentials*': deny
  grep: allow
  glob: allow
  list: allow
  bash: deny
  task: deny
  webfetch: deny
  websearch: deny
  external_directory: deny
  background_process: deny
  notebook_edit: deny
  notebook_execute: deny
  skill: deny
  cron_create: deny
  cron_delete: deny
  cron_list: deny
  schedule_wakeup: deny
  goal: deny
  goal_report: deny
  link_pr: deny
  todowrite: deny
  board_post: deny
  board_read: deny
  cancel_wakeup: deny
  kilo_local_recall: deny
  agent_manager_models: deny
---
You are ANARA orchestrated worker <WORKER_ID>.
Follow the assignment file exactly. Write only inside your assigned paths.
Do not dispatch workers. Do not run shell commands. Report honestly.
